title: "until end of turn" missing, so the effect never ends (11 cards)
body:
These cards say "until end of turn" but encode no expiration, so the effect never ends:

- `GainControlOfPermanent` / `GainControlOfEachPermanent`: Broadcast Takeover, Goatnapper, Mob Rule, Yasova Dragonclaw
- `CreatePermanentLayerEffect`: Bloodfeather Phoenix, Eye of Malcator, Kaya, Spirits' Justice, Lazav, Wearer of Faces, Majestic Metamorphosis, Silvanus's Invoker, The Mechanist, Aerial Artisan
